_schema: Each model: id (unique), displayName, engine, sizeBytes (>0), sha256 (64 lower-case hex), licence, url (https://). Parsed and validated by com.yazses.core.model.ModelCatalogue. URLs are pinned to a Hugging Face commit so a replaced upstream file cannot silently change what is downloaded. SHA-256 values computed with sha256sum on the file downloaded from the URL below; upstream SHA-1 in the ggerganov/whisper.cpp README matched those files.
